advisor_identified: McGill University historian specializing in medieval history, historiography and critical theory; co-supervisor of the listed 2005 dissertation.

evidence.says: McGill identifies Nancy Partner as a history professor, gives her degree as PhD (University of California at Berkeley), and lists medieval history, historiography and critical theory as her graduate supervision fields.

Mary Elizabeth Berry’s survey of Berkeley history PhD recipients lists Nancy F. Partner under 1975 (p. 21), identifies her as a longtime McGill professor, and describes her dissertation subject as twelfth-century England.

The indexed title page identifies the listed dissertation as Maria del Carmen Suescun Pozas’s 2005 McGill PhD thesis. Its indexed acknowledgements name Christine Ross, Catherine LeGrand and Nancy Partner as doctoral supervisors.

notes: The advisor’s independently documented institution, department, year and dissertation subject match the linked AHA record. The exact dissertation title was not independently confirmed, so title is null. Student-thesis evidence was available in indexed excerpts; the direct PDF fetch failed.
